title: download_blob: None and Some("") for accept_type are indistinguishable
description: accept_type: None and accept_type: Some("") both expand {type} to empty string, producing ?accept= in URLs that contain that variable. The doc warns about this but notes 'the server should omit {type}' — a burden on a party the caller doesn't control. Callers who want 'no preference' but get a server with ?accept= in the template have no way to suppress the parameter without knowing the template structure. This will generate support issues. Consider: if accept_type is None and the template contains {type}, either omit the whole query parameter (requires template parsing) or document clearly that None means "empty string, not absent".
